#  41510 - Pre Professional Training Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **41510 - module is no longer offered from WS 2011/12**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Pre Professional Training**  |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. PD Dr.-Ing. habil. Molkenthin, Frank 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Professional Environment Knowledge  |  
| Contents:  | This interdisciplinary module is dedicated to an intensive course focused on acquisition of pro-fessional skills as professional organizations, international structures and organizations, legal environment of companies, communication, ICT for engineering activities, written and oral pres-entation, reporting and synthesis. The module will be offered to all partners of the consortium and concluded by an intensive course after Hydro-Europe.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | 1 year of curriculum  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Practical training / 180 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | Manuals  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | Identification of Professional Project  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | Location: University Nice FranceTeaching at BTUC: Prof. Molkenthin, Prof. Gourbesville  |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment
